name: Carolina
subtitle: Zone offense: 2-1-2, flood the corner
goal: Get the ball to the corner and flood that side for a 4-on-3.
options: Best: 5 on the block or 3 at the elbow. Safety: back out to 2, then reverse through 1.
versus: 1-3-1 zone, including when we get trapped

steps.note: 2 dribbles to the wing. 1 fills backwards behind the ball for the reversal. No long passes across the top.
2 passes to 4 in the corner. On that pass, 5 dives from the nail to the ball-side block and 3 flashes to the ball-side elbow.
4-on-3. Corner, don't panic: 5 on the block, 3 at the elbow, or back out to 2 on the wing.
